divergences.reason: Node passed SDK maxRetries 4 under the agent's 3 retries. Rust has one retry layer (RetryPolicy, default 3), so there is no SDK-level retry setting.
Same as anthropic-client-options: single retry layer.
Node returns silently from an empty stream; Rust reports InvalidResponse 'empty stream' so the harness never treats it as an empty answer.
Fixture ends without message_stop (truncated stream). Node ends silently; Rust reports InvalidResponse 'stream ended before message_stop'. Events up to the cut are identical.

Gateway sent finish_reason but no usage chunk. Node never emits message_delta/message_stop. Rust synthesizes them at end of stream (usage left unreported, not zeroed) so consumers always see a terminated message. Chunk-level events are identical to Node.
Test artifact: Node serializes 0 as integer, Rust as 0.0 (same JSON number to the API).
Capture artifact: golden input.json has sorted keys, but Node stringified the original key order (type before source). Rust stringifies the order it was given.
